alerts.name: HudFlowErrors
alerts.note: Both OpenSearch HudFlowErrors rules (non-SQS and SQS) are this one alert: an SQS flow divides by its messages, every other flow by its runs. HTTP 4xx are excluded. Value is the error rate; there is no row below 1 error or 1%.
gaps: An issue row has no status code column: 4xx is told from framework_result, and the method and path come from the flow's runs.
alerts.sql:
SELECT
  toDateTime(toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}), INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} SECOND), 'UTC') AS ts,
  service AS job,
  env AS deployment_environment_name,
  flow_type AS code_flow_type,
  flow AS code_flow_name,
  method AS endpoint_method,
  if(route = '', flow, route) AS endpoint_path,
  fingerprint AS issue_fingerprint,
  errors / runs AS value
FROM (
  SELECT env, service, flow_type, flow, fingerprint,
    sumIf(issues, NOT match(framework_result, '^4..$')) AS errors,
    sum(sum(if(flow_type = 'sqs', messages, toFloat64(calls)))) OVER flow_rows AS runs,
    max(max(method)) OVER flow_rows AS method, max(max(route)) OVER flow_rows AS route
  FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_union
  WHERE t > toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC') - INTERVAL 20 MINUTE AND t <= toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC') - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE
  GROUP BY env, service, flow_type, flow, fingerprint
  WINDOW flow_rows AS (PARTITION BY env, service, flow_type, flow)
)
WHERE errors >= 1
  AND runs > 0
  AND errors / runs >= 0.01

alerts.name: HudWeekOverWeekDegradation
alerts.description: Average hourly p90 over the last 7d is {{value}}x the previous 7d (alert at >= 1.7x, >= 350 invocations per week, >= 84 hourly buckets, p90 >= 150ms).
alerts.note: Same gates as the OpenSearch rule: hourly p90 ratio, bucket counts, sd/avg, non-overlapping 99% intervals, window p90 and invocation counts. Evaluated every hour over 14 days of the hourly table.
gaps: Percentiles come from the SDK's exponential buckets through hud_duration_quantile, not the AMP native histogram and not Hud's DDSketch.
Reads complete hours of the hourly tables, by the hour an SDK export ends in: the hour in progress is not counted.
No per-entity overrides, exclusion lists, session tags, or issue lifecycle.
alerts.sql:
WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT
  toDateTime(toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}), INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} SECOND), 'UTC') AS ts,
  service AS job,
  env AS deployment_environment_name,
  flow_type AS code_flow_type,
  flow AS code_flow_name,
  method AS endpoint_method,
  if(route = '', flow, route) AS endpoint_path,
  cur_avg / ref_avg AS value
FROM (
  SELECT env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route,
    avgIf(p90, cur) AS cur_avg, stddevPopIf(p90, cur) AS cur_sd, countIf(cur) AS cur_n,
    avgIf(p90, NOT cur) AS ref_avg, stddevPopIf(p90, NOT cur) AS ref_sd, countIf(NOT cur) AS ref_n,
    sumIf(runs, cur) AS cur_runs, sumIf(runs, NOT cur) AS ref_runs,
    hud_duration_quantile(0.9, sumMapIf(bk, cur)) AS cur_p90
  FROM (
    SELECT env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route, hour, hour >= toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 168 HOUR AS cur,
      sum(duration_count) AS runs, sumMap(buckets) AS bk, hud_duration_quantile(0.9, bk) AS p90
    FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h
    WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 336 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC'))
    GROUP BY env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route, hour
    HAVING runs > 0
  )
  GROUP BY env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route
)
WHERE cur_avg / ref_avg >= 1.7
  AND cur_n >= 84
  AND ref_n >= 84
  AND cur_sd / cur_avg <= 1
  AND ref_sd / ref_avg <= 1
  AND ref_avg + 2.58 * ref_sd / sqrt(ref_n) < cur_avg - 2.58 * cur_sd / sqrt(cur_n)
  AND cur_p90 >= 0.15
  AND cur_runs >= 350
  AND ref_runs >= 350

alerts.name: HudDayOverWeekDegradation
alerts.description: Average hourly p90 over the last 24h is {{value}}x the preceding 7 days (alert at >= 1.7x, >= 100 invocations per window, >= 12 hourly buckets today and >= 84 in the baseline, p90 >= 150ms).
alerts.note: Scheduled equivalent of Hud's on-demand day-over-week check. Hourly.
gaps: Percentiles come from the SDK's exponential buckets through hud_duration_quantile, not the AMP native histogram and not Hud's DDSketch.
Reads complete hours of the hourly tables, by the hour an SDK export ends in: the hour in progress is not counted.

    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile

  toDateTime(toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}), INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} SECOND), 'UTC') AS ts,
  service AS job,
  env AS deployment_environment_name,
  flow_type AS code_flow_type,
  flow AS code_flow_name,
  method AS endpoint_method,
  if(route = '', flow, route) AS endpoint_path,
  cur_avg / ref_avg AS value
FROM (
  SELECT env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route,
    avgIf(p90, cur) AS cur_avg, stddevPopIf(p90, cur) AS cur_sd, countIf(cur) AS cur_n,
    avgIf(p90, NOT cur) AS ref_avg, stddevPopIf(p90, NOT cur) AS ref_sd, countIf(NOT cur) AS ref_n,
    sumIf(runs, cur) AS cur_runs, sumIf(runs, NOT cur) AS ref_runs,
    hud_duration_quantile(0.9, sumMapIf(bk, cur)) AS cur_p90
  FROM (
    SELECT env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route, hour, hour >= toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AS cur,
      sum(duration_count) AS runs, sumMap(buckets) AS bk, hud_duration_quantile(0.9, bk) AS p90
    FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h
    WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 192 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC'))
    GROUP BY env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route, hour
    HAVING runs > 0
  )
  GROUP BY env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route
)
WHERE cur_avg / ref_avg >= 1.7
  AND cur_n >= 12
  AND ref_n >= 84
  AND cur_sd / cur_avg <= 1
  AND ref_sd / ref_avg <= 1
  AND ref_avg + 2.58 * ref_sd / sqrt(ref_n) < cur_avg - 2.58 * cur_sd / sqrt(cur_n)
  AND cur_p90 >= 0.15
  AND cur_runs >= 100
  AND ref_runs >= 100

alerts.name: HudLatencySpike
alerts.description: p90 over the last 10m is {{value}}x the average 10m p90 of the previous day (alert at >= 1.7x, >= 50 invocations per window, p90 >= 300ms).
alerts.note: The window is still 10m against the previous 23h50m, in 10-minute steps back from the evaluation time. ClickStack has no 10m schedule, so this evaluates every 5m.
gaps: Percentiles come from the SDK's exponential buckets through hud_duration_quantile, not the AMP native histogram and not Hud's DDSketch.
No 10-minute alert interval. The schedule is 5m; the window stays 10m.
Reads a day of the fine table on every evaluation.
alerts.sql:
WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT
  toDateTime(toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}), INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} SECOND), 'UTC') AS ts,
  service AS job,
  env AS deployment_environment_name,
  flow_type AS code_flow_type,
  flow AS code_flow_name,
  method AS endpoint_method,
  if(route = '', flow, route) AS endpoint_path,
  cur_p90 / ref_avg AS value
FROM (
  SELECT env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route,
    hud_duration_quantile(0.9, sumMapIf(bk, age = 0)) AS cur_p90, sumIf(runs, age = 0) AS cur_runs,
    avgIf(p90, age > 0) AS ref_avg, stddevPopIf(p90, age > 0) AS ref_sd, countIf(age > 0) AS ref_n,
    sumIf(runs, age > 0) AS ref_runs
  FROM (
    SELECT env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route, intDiv(dateDiff('second', t, toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')), 600) AS age,
      sum(duration_count) AS runs, sumMap(buckets) AS bk, hud_duration_quantile(0.9, bk) AS p90
    FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations
    WHERE t > toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC') - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND t <= toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')
    GROUP BY env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route, age
    HAVING runs > 0
  )
  GROUP BY env, service, flow_type, flow, method, route
)
WHERE cur_p90 / ref_avg >= 1.7
  AND cur_p90 >= 0.3
  AND ref_n >= 72
  AND ref_sd / ref_avg <= 1
  AND ref_avg + 2.58 * ref_sd / sqrt(ref_n) < cur_p90
  AND cur_runs >= 50
  AND ref_runs >= 50

alerts.name: HudErrorRateSpike
alerts.description: Error {{attributes.issue_fingerprint}} rate {{value}} over the last hour (>= 5%), above twice its p99 hourly rate of the previous 8 days (>= 50 invocations).
alerts.note: Alpha, same as the OpenSearch rule. SQS uses message count; other flows use the run count. A fingerprint with no baseline hour does not fire. Hours with fewer than 20 invocations are left out of the baseline.
gaps: An issue row has no status code column: 4xx is told from framework_result, and the method and path come from the flow's runs.
Reads complete hours of the hourly tables, by the hour an SDK export ends in: the hour in progress is not counted.
alerts.sql:
SELECT
  toDateTime(toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}), INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} SECOND), 'UTC') AS ts,
  service AS job,
  env AS deployment_environment_name,
  flow_type AS code_flow_type,
  flow AS code_flow_name,
  method AS endpoint_method,
  if(route = '', flow, route) AS endpoint_path,
  fingerprint AS issue_fingerprint,
  rate AS value
FROM (
  SELECT env, service, flow_type, flow, fingerprint, max(method) AS method, max(route) AS route,
    sumIf(errors / runs, hour = toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS rate, sumIf(runs, hour = toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS last_runs,
    quantileExactInclusiveIf(0.99)(errors / runs, NOT (hour = toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND runs >= 20) AS baseline,
    countIf(NOT (hour = toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND runs >= 20) AS baseline_n
  FROM (
    SELECT env, service, flow_type, flow, fingerprint, hour, sum(issues) AS errors
    FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h
    WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 193 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) AND issues > 0 AND NOT match(framework_result, '^4..$')
    GROUP BY env, service, flow_type, flow, fingerprint, hour
  ) AS i
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT env, service, flow_type, flow, hour, max(method) AS method, max(route) AS route,
      if(flow_type = 'sqs', sum(messages), toFloat64(sum(duration_count))) AS runs
    FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h
    WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 193 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC'))
    GROUP BY env, service, flow_type, flow, hour
    HAVING runs > 0
  ) AS d USING (env, service, flow_type, flow, hour)
  GROUP BY env, service, flow_type, flow, fingerprint
)
WHERE rate >= 0.05
  AND baseline_n >= 1
  AND rate > 2 * baseline
  AND last_runs >= 50

alerts.name: HudFunctionDayOverWeekDegradation
alerts.description: Function p90 over the last 24h is {{value}}x the preceding 7 days (alert at >= 1.7x, >= 100 calls in both windows, p90 >= 150ms).
alerts.note: Not installed. The function regex is __NO_FUNCTION_SELECTED__, which matches nothing. Set that regex to the functions you watch and import with --include-inert. Function durations are sampled, calls are not.
gaps: Percentiles come from the SDK's exponential buckets through hud_duration_quantile, not the AMP native histogram and not Hud's DDSketch.
Reads complete hours of the hourly tables, by the hour an SDK export ends in: the hour in progress is not counted.
Inert until the function regex is edited. Import skips it unless --include-inert.
alerts.sql:
WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT
  toDateTime(toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}), INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} SECOND), 'UTC') AS ts,
  service AS job,
  env AS deployment_environment_name,
  function AS code_function_name,
  file AS code_file_path,
  function AS endpoint_path,
  cur_p90 / ref_p90 AS value
FROM (
  SELECT env, service, function, file,
    hud_duration_quantile(0.9, sumMapIf(buckets, hour >= toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) AS cur_p90,
    hud_duration_quantile(0.9, sumMapIf(buckets, NOT (hour >= toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 24 HOUR))) AS ref_p90,
    sumIf(calls, hour >= toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS cur_calls, sumIf(calls, NOT (hour >= toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) AS ref_calls
  FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_lean_1h
  WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC')) - INTERVAL 192 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour(toDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), 'UTC'))
    AND match(function, '^(?:__NO_FUNCTION_SELECTED__)$')
  GROUP BY env, service, function, file
)
WHERE cur_p90 / ref_p90 >= 1.7
  AND cur_p90 >= 0.15
  AND cur_calls >= 100
  AND ref_calls >= 100
